changes.title: Quest boss records
changes.text: The Bosses table now includes recorded Crystal Spire, Gnoll Geomancer, Fungal Core and Vault Elemental encounters from finished runs.

changes.title: Existing boss statistics
changes.text: Rebuilt obsolete derived row caches so previously recorded quest bosses receive the corrected classification without changing original history.

changes.title: Quest boss regressions
changes.text: Added actual boss-property, recorded encounter, unfinished privacy, RNG preservation and old-cache recovery checks.

changes.title: Audit checkpoint
changes.text: Recorded further component reviews and verified regression findings while keeping the comprehensive audit explicitly incomplete.

changes.title: Developer Commentary
changes.text: I restored missing quest bosses to their statistics category and made existing cached records rebuild correctly. Enemy behavior, gameplay and original player data are unchanged.
